meta.title: E-invoice to JSON
meta.description: Convert an EU e-invoice (Peppol BIS 3, XRechnung, Factur-X, Svefaktura and more) to canonical JSON, entirely in your browser.
lang.label: Language
masthead.lede: Drop an e-invoice you received. It is unwrapped, identified and mapped to one canonical model built on EN 16931. You get the JSON, and the invoice rebuilt from it so you can check the mapping.
masthead.privacy: Nothing leaves this tab. The conversion runs in your browser; files are never uploaded.

tray.drop: Drop an invoice here or choose a file

coverage.title: What it reads, country by country
coverage.intro: Every EU country also sends Peppol BIS Billing 3.0, which converts fully. The tiles show each country's own formats.
coverage.worldNote: Peppol PINT jurisdictions and Saudi ZATCA, mapped on top of the UBL parser. The PINT Schematron is not bundled, so these get the UBL schema check only.
coverage.checklist: See the conformance checklist for every format: fixtures, parser, real samples, mapping source and validation.
coverage.wrappers: Wrappers it opens: Factur-X and ZUGFeRD PDF attachments, CAdES .p7m (binary or base64), ZIP archives such as ANAF downloads and ISDOCX, Peppol SBDH, SOAP envelopes, and legacy encodings such as ISO-8859-1 and ISO-8859-15.
footer.colophon: Open source (0BSD), built on the eu-einvoice-canonical library. No analytics and no cookies: the only outside requests are the fonts and the trusted lists or language models you switch on.
sample.svefakturaDescriptors: Svefaktura 1.0 with headings and a 8 % markup (Sweden)
sample.zatca: ZATCA simplified tax invoice, signed (Saudi Arabia)

deliv.title: Deliverables
deliv.description: Everything this project publishes: TypeScript types, JSON Schemas, the OpenAPI spec, CLI binaries, the browser converter, the conformance checklist and the corpus results.
deliv.lede: The interface is the product: the types, the schemas, the HTTP API, the command line and the evidence behind them. Each one is generated from the same TypeScript sources, so they cannot drift apart.
deliv.versions: Versions: package {package}, JSON Schema {schema}, HTTP API /{schema}. See Deliverables and versioning for the compatibility promise.
deliv.libBody: convert(), inspect(), detectXml() and the CanonicalInvoice model, with the BT/BG ids in the comments. ES modules, no native code; runs in Bun, Node 20+ and browsers.
deliv.apiBody: POST /v1/convert, /v1/inspect, /v1/detect, GET /v1/formats, /v1/schemas/{name}. Errors are RFC 9457 problems in the CLI's exit-code categories. Run it with einvoice serve or the Dockerfile.
deliv.cliBody: Standalone binaries for linux-x64, darwin-arm64 and windows-x64: detect, inspect, convert, match, duplicates, sweep and serve.
deliv.browserBody: Drop a file, get the JSON and the rebuilt invoice. Everything runs in the tab; nothing is uploaded.
deliv.confBody: Per format: fixtures, parser, real samples, mapping source and validation, generated from the code on every build.
deliv.corpusBody: Detection and conversion over public sample collections, run weekly and never on a pull request.
deliv.schemasBody: Draft 2020-12, generated from the types, published at stable URLs. Objects are open, so a payload from a newer minor release still validates against an older schema.
deliv.schemaCanonical: One invoice in the canonical model (CanonicalInvoice).
deliv.footer: Built on the open-source eu-einvoice-canonical library. Licensed 0BSD.
relations.title: Lines that talk about other lines
relations.body: Invoices mix items, headings, notes and adjustments. The Lines tab shows deterministic relations and lets you export canonical input for a model, then validate its annotations separately. Imported interpretations always need review.
relations.eval: See how well the models do
model.learn: How it works and how well it does.
model.title: Label lines with a language model
model.explain: Rules already sort lines into items, headings and surcharges. A small language model can also spot freight, labour and discounts in any language, and may link a heading to its items. It runs in this tab and nothing you load is sent anywhere. Every answer is marked for review, and no amount ever changes.

strip.body: Peppol BIS 3 from every EU country, and national formats such as XRechnung, Factur-X, FatturaPA and KSeF. It also opens PDF attachments, signed .p7m files, ZIP archives, Peppol SBDH and SOAP envelopes.

annotation.title: Line annotations
annotation.explain: Export the selected canonical JSON for your model, then paste its response here. This page sends no invoice data to a model.
annotation.origins: Value origins distinguish source, derived and defaulted values. Missing entries mean unrecorded; a defaulted zero does not establish a line’s role.
annotation.importHint: Paste the complete JSON object with id and lines. Validation checks structure and identifiers, not whether the interpretation is correct.
annotation.unreviewed: These annotations are unreviewed and separate from the original invoice. They do not change its lines, amounts or canonical JSON.
val.local: Source XML checks run locally in your browser. No invoice is uploaded.
val.cancelled: Local validation cancelled. Convert the document again to retry.
